hero.title: Premium Nitrogen Fertilizers
hero.desc: Powering global agriculture with high-purity Urea solutions. From source to soil, we ensure quality, consistency, and reliable delivery for your crop yields.

header.title: What is Urea 46% Nitrogen?
header.desc: The world's most concentrated solid nitrogen fertilizer, essential for healthy plant growth and maximum yield efficiency.

desc.desc: Our urea provides a high concentration of nitrogen in a form that is easy to handle and store. It promotes rapid vegetative growth and strengthens the root system.

1.title: Cost Effective
1.desc: Lowest cost per unit of nitrogen compared to other fertilizers.

2.title: Versatile Application
2.desc: Suitable for soil application, fertigation, and foliar sprays.
